task: Create a topology-aware StorageClass and a claim that provisions on first consumer scheduling.
verify: PVC binds after a consuming Pod schedules
Pod writes and rereads a marker
risk: Use a disposable class and namespace; do not alter a default class.

competency: volume types, access modes and reclaim policies
task: Select access mode and reclaim policy for single-node writable retained evidence, then explain alternatives.
verify: storage backend actually supports the selected mode
risk: Retain leaves infrastructure requiring deliberate cleanup.

task: Diagnose a Pending PVC and make the smallest correction without deleting data.
risk: Never delete a bound production claim while diagnosing.

task: Recover a NotReady worker caused by one kubelet/runtime/network dependency fault.
verify: node conditions and service logs identify root cause
risk: Confirm node identity before service or configuration changes.

task: Repair one broken control-plane static Pod configuration.
verify: manifest and component logs identify defect
risk: Back up the manifest and change one component at a time.

task: Identify the highest CPU and memory consumers and relate usage to requests/limits.
risk: Metrics availability depends on a working metrics pipeline.

task: Diagnose a restarting container using current and previous logs.
risk: Do not replace forensic evidence with an immediate Pod deletion.

task: Repair a Service with no usable endpoint or incorrect target port.
risk: Changing a Service selector can redirect production traffic.

task: Update an image with bounded unavailability, detect a failed rollout, and roll back.
verify: rollout status fails for intended reason
risk: Use a deliberately invalid test image only in a disposable namespace.

task: Configure nonsecret and secret values appropriately and trigger safe workload consumption.
verify: values reach process without appearing in Pod spec plaintext
rollout behavior after change is understood
risk: Base64 is encoding, not encryption; never put real secrets in training artifacts.

task: Configure CPU HPA and explain why replicas do or do not change under load.
verify: HPA conditions and desired replicas observed
risk: Load generators and scale limits must be bounded.

task: Add distinct startup/readiness/liveness behavior to prevent premature traffic and restart deadlock.
verify: unready Pod receives no Service traffic
temporary startup does not trigger liveness restart
risk: Aggressive liveness probes can cause cascading failure.

task: Schedule a workload using requests, taints/tolerations and required or preferred affinity as stated.
verify: Pod lands only on acceptable topology
unsatisfiable variant remains Pending for explained reason
risk: Required affinity and broad taints can make workloads unschedulable.

task: Grant one service account read-only access to selected namespaced resources and prove denials.
verify: can-i checks for positive and negative paths
binding references correct Role and subject
risk: Avoid cluster-admin and broad ClusterRoleBinding shortcuts.

task: Initialize a disposable control plane and join a worker with compatible runtime/network prerequisites.
risk: Run only on dedicated disposable hosts; kubeadm changes host networking and state.

competency: cluster lifecycle and HA control plane
task: Plan or perform a supported one-minor upgrade while preserving control-plane availability.
risk: Never skip unsupported versions or upgrade every control-plane node simultaneously.

task: Render and install one component with an override, then diagnose a values or overlay error.
risk: Inspect cluster-scoped resources and CRDs before installation.

competency: CNI, CSI and CRI extension interfaces
task: Given three failures, identify whether networking, storage, or runtime integration owns each symptom.
risk: Restarting unrelated components wastes time and may widen impact.

task: Install a disposable CRD/controller pair and distinguish API acceptance from reconciliation.
risk: A CRD alone adds schema/API storage but no operator behavior.

task: Diagnose cross-Pod and DNS resolution paths separately.
risk: Do not assume every timeout is DNS.

task: Apply default deny, then allow only gateway ingress and DNS plus one required egress dependency.
risk: Policies are additive and can cause broad outage if selectors are wrong.

task: Expose the same workload appropriately with ClusterIP and reason about NodePort and LoadBalancer effects.
risk: LoadBalancer and NodePort can create unintended exposure or cost.

task: Attach an HTTPRoute to an allowed Gateway listener and diagnose a non-Accepted or unresolved backend.
verify: parent and backend status conditions inspected
risk: A route object alone does not create a controller or data plane.

task: Create an Ingress rule and distinguish resource correctness from missing controller behavior.
risk: Ingress API objects are inert without a controller.
